native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] RagnarLocker Ransomware
native_rule.s1ql:
event.category = 'Process'
AND
(
  (
    (
      tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'R^A^G^N^A^R_'
      OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'R!A!G!N!A!R_'
    )
    AND NOT
    (
      src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'explorer.exe'
      OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Program Files'
    )
    AND src.process.pid != '0'
  )
  OR
  (
    src.process.commandLine RegExp '\.exe\s{1,2}\-pass\s[a-zA-Z0-9]{8,24}$'
    AND NOT
    (
      src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Program Files'
    )
  )
)
